original.target_description: Bivariate correlation between perceived informal competition obstacle and introduction of new or upgraded products/services over previous 36 months; BEEPS firm sample.

n.exclusions: Missing values excluded, leaving 10,053; 421 respondents rated not truthful and 110 providing arbitrary/unreliable information excluded, leaving 9,522 (p. 1526).

es.location: p. 1528, Table 1, row (2) Informal competition, column (1) New product development

p.quote: Correlations in bold are significant at p < 0.05.
